items.title: Bitcoin network used by exchanges hit by $320 million exploit. Hackers claim they're the 'good guys'
items.snippet: Liquid Network, a settlement layer used by exchanges, halted all transactions after losing $320 million worth of bitcoin in a security exploit.
items.note: Негативний тон для BTC за ключовими словами -- варто звернути увагу.

items.title: ‘White hats’ take 4000 BTC from Liquid, ETFs see best inflows of 2026: Hodler’s Digest
items.snippet: Purported white hat hackers have taken 4000 Bitcoin from the Liquid sidechain in a major security breach. The Bitcoin ETFs see the best three weeks of inflows in 2026.
items.note: Нейтрально щодо BTC -- прямого сигналу на ціну за ключовими словами не видно.
